WITH cur AS (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE is_current AND subcategory = 'Interior Paint'),
anyv AS (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE subcategory = 'Interior Paint')
SELECT p.sku, p.product_key, p.product_name, p.category, p.subcategory, p.valid_from, p.valid_to, p.is_current, p.listed_from, p.delisted_on,
  (p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM cur)) AS cur_ip
FROM dim_product p
WHERE p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM anyv)
  AND p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku HAVING count(*) > 1 OR count(DISTINCT subcategory) > 1)
ORDER BY p.sku, p.valid_from

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_week, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines,
  sum(f.quantity) AS units, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity < 0 THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS neg_units, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_loaded, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_loaded,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = 108) AS closures
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT sum(f.quantity) AS units_by_sale_date,
  sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_by_helsinki_ts,
  sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <> f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS date_mismatch_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code <> 'ST' OR f.channel_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_st_lines,
  count(DISTINCT p.sku) AS skus
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

SELECT sum(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned_in_period
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
